procedure.title: Component Naming from Blade Path
procedure.step: Identify the Blade view path relative to resources/views/. Example: admin/tasks/index.blade.php.
Strip the .blade.php extension and the resources/views/ prefix. Result: admin/tasks/index.
Convert each segment to PascalCase and concatenate: admin → Admin, tasks → Tasks, index → Index. Result: AdminTasksIndex.
If the last segment is "index", you may drop it: AdminTasks.

procedure.title: React.memo for Toggling Components
procedure.step: Identify components that toggle (mount/unmount) frequently: modals, accordions, dialogs, dropdowns, tooltips.
Optionally provide a custom comparison function as the second argument to memo if shallow comparison is insufficient.

procedure.step:

procedure.title: Error Boundary Setup
procedure.step:
Install react-error-boundary (if not already):
npm install react-error-boundary
Place error boundaries at route/feature level — not around every individual component. Typically in layout.tsx or route wrappers.
